found.name: Generative AI Literacies module on Moodle
found.quote: Please take the time to complete this module before you start any assessment and remember to check your assessment briefs to identify if you are permitted to use AI or ask a tutor if you are unsure.
On this site you can also find helpful information on a range of associated topics, including prompt engineering, critically evaluating sources and the different types of GenAI tools available.

found.name: Academic Conduct and GenAI Declaration tile
found.quote: the Academic Conduct and GenAI Declaration tile on the GenAI Literacies Moodle module offers further guidance and step by step instructions about how to check whether you can use GenAI and how to declare its use.
